Question
========
Why should sensitive data requirements be planned beforehand?

Answerlist
----------
* Because sensitive data are never stored
* Because legal restrictions may apply
* Because metadata cannot be used
* Because participants should have designated time slot to demand their personal data back


Solution
========
Sensitive data requirements should be planned beforehand because legal restrictions may apply.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
